summaries.text: This resolution designates June 15, 2025, as World Elder Abuse Awareness Day. The resolution also designates June 2025 as Elder Abuse Awareness Month.

title: A resolution designating June 15, 2025, as "World Elder Abuse Awareness Day" and the month of June 2025 as "Elder Abuse Awareness Month".
